name: Request to Extend the Approval of the Planned Development and Development Agreement, and Vesting Tentative Parcel Map No. 74993 for the Elegance Senior Assisted Living Project at 806-824 S. Gladys Avenue (Planning Case No. PL15-149)
agenda_text:
City of San Gabriel
  MEMORANDUM
DATE:  November 8, 2022

TO:  Honorable Mayor and City Council

FROM:  Mark Lazzaretto, City Manager

BY:  Aldo Cervantes, Director of Community Development

SUBJECT:  Request to Extend the Approval of the Planned Development and
  Development Agreement, and Vesting Tentative Parcel Map No. 74993
  for the Elegance Senior Assisted Living Project at 806-824 S. Gladys
  Avenue (Planning Case No. PL15-149)

Attached for your information is a letter from Mr. Richard Koors, a representative of the
San Gabriel AL Real Estate, LLC, regarding a request to extend the Planned Development
and Development Agreement, and Vesting Tentative Parcel Map No. 74993 (Planning
Case No. 15-149) for a senior assisted living project located at 806-824 S. Gladys Avenue
for twelve (12) months.

Referred to as Elegance (formerly known as Symphony), the proposed project consists of
197 units of senior independent living, assisted living, and memory care center. The
Planned Development would create an overlay zone encompassing the site, which
includes two parcels merged together by the Vesting Tentative Parcel Map. The
Development Agreement would define customized land use and development standards,
relative to density, building setbacks, heights, form, mass scale, and conditions of approval
for the proposed project. These land use entitlements were approved by the City Council
effective January 4, 2019 through January 4, 2023.

Pursuant to Section 5.02, Administrative Amendments, it is under my authority as
community development director to approve and authorize the extension of the project's
Planned Development and Development Agreement and Vesting Tentative Parcel Map
No. 74993. Therefore, I approve this request for an extension until January 4, 2024.

Pursuant to Section 5.01, Amendment of Project Approvals, no administrative amendment
will be effective until after thirty (30) days' notice to the City Council and posting in the
same manner as agendas. If City Council requests consideration of such amendment
within the 30-day notice period, then the administrative amendment will not be effective
